info.title: NYALES implemented local identity, masters and people API
info.description: Request shapes generated from runtime Zod. Role-scoped reads and Management/NSM master writes. Response fields remain resource specific. Same-origin API, no cookie authentication; no production deployment proof.

post.summary: Activate explicitly selected first Management identity in an empty staging database

200.description: Same active initial administrator; existing mapping returned, no writes

201.description: Organization, active user, Management assignment and audit created in one D1 batch

401.description: Missing/invalid Firebase bearer or recent sign-in required

403.description: Google provider, verified email allowlist or signed MFA claim not satisfied

404.description: Disabled unless staging and both operator bootstrap variables are configured

409.description: Existing tenant, conflicting identity, failed atomic guard or unavailable database

post.x-access-policy: Staging only; exact operator-selected verified Google email, signed second-factor claim, auth_time at most five minutes; no role/UID/email supplied by client
post.x-constraints: No general signup. Database must have zero organizations, users and roles. A failed D1 batch rolls back every new record. Same original active administrator can replay without duplicate audit. Remove bootstrap variables after activation.
